title: OpenEPCIS extension (permissive): oec
description: Permissive capture schema for the https://ref.openepcis.io/extensions/common/core/ extension. Declares known terms as optional and allows additional properties, so events that declare GS1-Extensions oec=https://ref.openepcis.io/extensions/common/core/ validate and capture. Generated from the module JSON-LD context; tighten per ontology for field-level validation.
